key_insight: SCOPE compiles quantum circuits for shorter physical execution time using an operator Schmidt time surrogate rather than gate count or circuit depth.
engineering_relevance: Latency-guided compilation can help engineers shorten pulse schedules on coherence-limited quantum devices while avoiding pulse optimization for every structural candidate.
method: Estimate nonlocal implementation time from distance to product operators and a coupling-limited evolution-rate bound.
Combine this estimate with trace-angle and waveform constraints to guide genetic-search fitness and mutation-region selection.
Use local quantum optimal control (QOC) to determine final pulse durations.
evidence_signal: Under a numerical nearest-neighbor control model, all 104 results across 13 instances beat adapted EPOC, with a 42.50% equally weighted reduction in eight-run mean QOC critical-path duration and a 2.00× geometric mean speedup.
watch_item: Results are numerical and control-model-specific; performance on physical hardware and other device constraints remains to be validated.
paper_title: SCOPE: A Physical Execution Latency-Guided Quantum Circuit Compilation Framework
